verdict.rationale: PostHog documents a public REST/HTTP API (capture events from any language via HTTP), a live OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, an official CLI, and an official MCP server enabling AI agents to run queries, ship flags, and inspect stack traces — strong first-party evidence of a documented public API for programmatic/agentic use. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of API robustness/limits and no hands-on developer report specifically validating the REST API (only community complaints exist about an unrelated in-app AI feature).
